m-dash GLib security backport

This is glib 0.18.5 from the original crates.io archive, SHA-256:
233daaf6e83ae6a12a52055f568f9d7cf4671dabb78ff9560ab6da230ce00ee5
Upstream source: https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/glib/0.18.5/download
Patched source: https://github.com/chuck-quypto/m-dash/tree/main/vendor/glib

The only source change is the upstream VariantStrIter::impl_get fix:
https://github.com/gtk-rs/gtk-rs-core/commit/b5a4071e439bef2b5eea76c3aa25e5ae84839e34
It makes the output pointer mutable and passes &mut p to g_variant_get_child.
This fixes RUSTSEC-2024-0429 / GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g without changing the
glib 0.18 API required by Tauri's GTK3 dependencies. The upstream MIT license
and copyright notices are preserved.

Both app manifests patch crates.io glib to this shared directory. Remove the
patch once their GTK dependency chains support an officially patched release.
The optimized upstream variant_iter tests run in Linux CI to guard the fix.
